macros.name: AtBeginNote
macros.doc: The ⟨text⟩ will be inserted at the beginning of every note in the scope of the command.

macros.name: AtEndNote
macros.doc: This command behaves the same way as \AtBeginNote, except that the text is inserted at the end (bottom).

macros.name: note
macros.doc: This command appends the ⟨note text⟩ to the note that follows the current slide.
